actions.action: Remove pot from decorative bowl and bottom-soak in an inch of water for 15-30 minutes, then drain fully
Check that top inch of soil is dry or pot feels light before watering again
If bowl lacks drainage, keep pot in a separate saucer and use bowl as cover only
Move plant to brightest window, ideally south- or west-facing
If light is insufficient, set up a grow light for 12-14 hours a day
Snip off dead brown material and trim leggy stems
Repot in spring if root-bound or soil stays soggy

reason: It correctly identifies underwatering and recommends bottom-soaking, but it misses the poor soil and no-drainage pot, adds low light as a co-cause, and tells the owner not to repot even though repotting into a pot with drainage holes was the confirmed fix. The improved watering still helps, so this is not graded harmful.
